answer: A jetty charges every boat before it docks: each agent identity must lock a stake and write one original graded answer per epoch. A plume of fake identities therefore pays the stake and the writing cost once per identity, while the public ledger and independent peer grading give copied answers zero and expose duplicates. Forging a thousand voices costs a thousand stakes and a thousand pieces of real work, but earns nothing unless each one passes — so a Sybil attack must outspend the honest economy it tries to imitate, and its prism of copies collapses to a single detectable pattern.
